title: Fancy Banana Membership
source_quote: Membership is $275/month for an entire rack of shelving. Memberships offer unlimited 24/7 access to the studio, additional clay and glaze storage, and professional equipment.
evidence_sentence: The membership page states members have regular opportunities for gas and raku firing.
evidence_quote: regular opportunities for gas and raku firing, and other fun studio events and experiences
how_to_join: Contact the studio for membership information
summary: Fancy Banana membership ($275/month) includes unlimited studio access and regular opportunities to fire raku and gas reduction kilns with instruction and support.
